detail.command:
set -e
echo '=== INSTALL ==='
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi

echo '=== TYPECHECK ==='
npm run typecheck

echo '=== UI TESTS ==='
npm run test:ui

echo '=== LINT ==='
if npm run | grep -qE '^  lint($|:)'; then npm run lint; else echo 'No lint script'; fi

echo '=== BUILD ==='
npm run build

echo '=== CONFLICT CHECK ==='
if git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U | grep -q .; then git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U; exit 1; fi
if grep -R -nE '^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>)' src/ui; then exit 1; fi

echo '=== STATUS ==='
git status --short
